htn_kidney.title: Association of HA130/KHA80 hemoperfusion combined with hemodialysis with survival outcomes in patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis: a time-dependent and propensity score-matched analysis.
htn_kidney.authors: Liu Y, Gang W, Chen W
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：接受维持性血液透析（MHD）的患者面临着很高的死亡率负担，心血管疾病仍然是死亡的主要原因。 临床提示：本研究旨在评估辅助血液灌流联合常规血液透析 (HD + HP) 与接受 MHD 患者的长期生存结果之间的关系。
htn_kidney.abstract: Patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) experience a high mortality burden, with cardiovascular disease remaining a major cause of death. This study aimed to evaluate the association between adjunctive hemoperfusion combined with conventional hemodialysis (HD + HP) and long-term survival outcomes in patients receiving MHD. This single-center retrospective cohort study was conducted at Shanghai Changhai Hospital. Patients with end-stage renal disease who received MHD between January 2015 and December 2023 were retrospectively identified from the center's hemodialysis records. Among the 640 eligible patients, 419 (65.5%) received HD during the study period, whereas 221 (34.5%) receiv...

htn_kidney.title: Kidney disease in patients with two APOL1 risk variants.
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：肾脏病专家经常要求基因检测小组来澄清具有不同表现的肾脏疾病患者的诊断。 临床提示：十年前，也就是当前精准医疗时代之前，情况并非如此。
htn_kidney.abstract: Nephrologists often order genetic testing panels to clarify diagnoses in patients with diverse presentations of kidney disease. This was not the case 10 years ago, prior to the current era of precision medicine. In the past, elevated blood sugars and blood pressures were felt to be the primary factors that initiated diabetic and mislabeled "hypertensive" nephropathy. In addition, the markedly higher incidence rates of kidney failure in African Americans relative to European, Asian, and Hispanic Americans were poorly understood. This changed with recognition of marked familial aggregation of kidney failure, particularly in the African American population. The 2010 discovery of the apolipoprot...

portal_hypertension.title: Bile acids as the silent harbinger: Early signals of portal hypertension after "successful" Kasai.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：胆汁酸作为无声预兆：葛西“成功”后门静脉高压的早期信号。

portal_hypertension.title: Endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition: A targetable mechanism that contributes to portal vein thrombosis in cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Anton A, Shalaby S, Botero ML
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PVT 与内膜显着偏心增厚有关... 临床提示：门静脉血栓形成（PVT）是肝硬化的常见并发症，但其病理生理学仍然难以捉摸。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal vein thrombosis (PVT) is a frequent complication of cirrhosis, yet its pathophysiology remains elusive. Unlike thrombosis in other vascular beds, anticoagulation often fails to completely recanalize PVT, highlighting the need for greater mechanistic insight and alternative therapeutic approaches. Our study aimed to characterize the structural and cellular changes in the portal venous vascular bed to identify novel physiologically driven therapeutic targets. Portal vein tissue specimens from explanted livers of patients with cirrhosis with and without PVT and from liver donors were histologically analyzed. PVT is associated with a remarkable eccentric thickening of the tunica intima du...

portal_hypertension.title: Serum bile acid levels predict the development of portal hypertension and high-risk esophageal varices following successful Kasai in biliary atresia.
portal_hypertension.authors: Grimaud E, Gardin A, Ackermann O
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 60）。核心观点：尽管葛西手术 (KP) 成功，但胆道闭锁仍可导致门静脉高压 (PH)、高危食管静脉曲张 (HRV) 和肝移植。 临床提示：我们研究了 KP 后第一年测量的 sBA 对 KP 后 5 年内 PH 和 HRV 发展的预测价值。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Biliary atresia can lead to portal hypertension (PH), high-risk esophageal varices (HRV), and liver transplantation, despite a successful Kasai procedure (KP). Serum bile acids (sBA) can reflect residual cholestasis in patients with successful KP. We investigated the predictive value of sBA measured during the first year after KP on the development of PH and HRV within 5 years after KP. In this retrospective monocentric observational study, we included patients with biliary atresia who underwent a successful KP, defined as a total serum bilirubin level of ≤25 μmol/L within 6 months after KP, and in whom sBA were measured during the first year after KP (n=60). We collected clinical, biologica...

portal_hypertension.title: Hepatocyte-derived extracellular vesicles promote endothelial dedifferentiation in chronic liver disease through the miR-153-3p-pyroptosis axis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Abad-Jordà L, Andrés-Rozas M, Martínez-Alcocer A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 10）。核心观点：肝细胞通过细胞外囊泡 (EV) 进行旁分泌通讯。 临床提示：本研究调查了嵌入肝细胞源性 EV（hepEV）中的 microRNA（miRNA）在慢性肝病中调节内皮细胞去分化的作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver cells communicate paracrinally through extracellular vesicles (EVs). This study investigated the role of microRNAs (miRNAs) embedded in hepatocyte-derived EVs (hepEVs) modulating endothelial cell dedifferentiation in chronic liver disease. EVs were purified from primary hepatocytes isolated from healthy (CT) and cirrhotic (CH) livers in both humans and rats. CT-rats were intravenously treated with fluorescence-labeled hepEVs-CT or hepEVs-CH (200 μg/d, 3 d, n=10/group) to assess biodistribution and LSECs phenotype. miRNA profiling of human hepEVs-CH was validated in rat models, and commonly altered miRNAs were overexpressed in CT-LSECs. Gene dysregulation was analyzed in primary CH-LSEC...

portal_hypertension.title: Sinusoidal injury and portal hypertension after hepatectomy for colorectal liver metastases: predictors, risk stratification, and clinical outcomes.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hernández-Yagüe X, López-Ben S, Aula-Olivar A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 108）。核心观点：正弦波阻塞综合征 (SOS) 和早期门静脉高压 (ePHT) 是结直肠肝转移瘤 (CRLM) 术前化疗和肝切除术后明显的肝血管并发症。 临床提示：本研究旨在确定 SOS 和 ePHT 的预测因素，并开发术前分层的风险模型。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (SOS) and early portal hypertension (ePHT) represent significant hepatic vascular complications following preoperative chemotherapy and liver resection for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM). This study aimed to identify predictors of SOS and ePHT and to develop a risk model for preoperative stratification. A retrospective analysis was conducted in 108 patients undergoing hepatectomy for CRLM after ≥ 4 cycles of neoadjuvant chemotherapy combined with anti-EGFR or anti-VEGF therapy. SOS severity was graded histologically, and ePHT was defined by thrombocytopenia, splenomegaly, varices, or ascites within 3 months postoperatively. Logistic regression models ident...
